name: Alt2Obsidian
description: Import Alt (altalt.io) lecture notes into Obsidian as page-anchored markdown. Per-slide commentary from your Claude Code or Codex CLI (or Gemini/Ollama), hash-augmented markers preserve your callouts across re-imports, and a built-in Synced Viewer scrolls the PDF and notes in lockstep.
author: BiQnT
